name: Dickson Industries Inc
old_description: Since 1946, the Dickson name has guaranteed integrity, innovation, and a commitment to excellence. Generations of customers have relied on Dickson to deliver on our promise.
about:
Dickson Industries Inc. traces its roots to April 30, 1946, when Allied Manufacturing Co. was founded at 115 SW 8th Street in Des Moines, Iowa, to produce cotton stockinette for meat packers. Arthur D. Dickson, initially hired as a sales engineer, purchased the company in the 1960s, renamed it Dickson Industries, and moved operations to the Interstate Bakery Building at 325 SW 5th Street. The business remains a third‑generation, family‑owned enterprise; Arthur W. Dickson became president in 1972, and his son David Dickson assumed the role in 2014.

Today the company operates 216 high‑tech knitting machines and full cut‑and‑sew facilities across roughly 50,000 square feet, employing 49 people. Its product lines include custom knit fabrics, garments, and textile products: freezerwear and insulated apparel (Cold Room Coat, quilted vests), food‑processing nets and sleeves (DeliKnit, RoastKnit), industrial filtration covers (DrainKnit), and medical textiles such as PPE, lab coats, surgical drapes, and orthopedic fabrics. An in‑house embroidery division, Dickson Designs, adds custom branding.

Dickson serves food processors, medical and healthcare providers, industrial filtration OEMs, hospitality and footwear brands, and geotextile markets. Customers range from national meat‑packing plants to hospitals and international distributors, with the company’s centralized Midwest location enabling quick delivery across the United States.

The Dickson name emphasizes integrity, innovation, and a commitment to excellence backed by SQF certification (achieved in 2018) for food‑safety assurance. The company highlights confidential custom development, thorough testing, cost containment, and responsive service—including emergency shipping—as core differentiators.
